replication.target_description: Replication 1, goal conflict versus no conflict in the work-framed book-browsing task: natural log of seconds, with times above 300 seconds winsorized to 300. Matched using named replication and outcome/frame descriptions.

n.sample_role: Participants in the work-frame subset of Replication 1; analytic subset count unresolved.
n.exclusions: Attention-check failures, survey durations over 30 minutes, duplicate MTurk IDs or IP addresses, and mismatched actual/reported MTurk IDs excluded. Supplied totals are after exclusions but combine task frames.
n.location: The Replications, post-exclusion sample paragraph; exclusion footnote.
n.quote: After exclusions, we wound up with 1,008 participants in Replication 1 and 1,127 participants in Replication 2 (~5 times the original sample size).

p.location: Fourth footnote, time cap and winsorization, final sentence.
p.quote: For example, if we do not winsorize in this way in Replication 1, the work-frame p-value becomes .264 instead of .270, and the leisure-frame p-value remains at .088.

notes: Identity assessment: supplied cache names https://datacolada.org/97, the exact referenced [97] Data Replicada #10 title, May 4, 2021, and byline Joe & Leif. It reports its authors’ own two replications of Etkin and Memmi Study 1a, establishing primary replication-report status. The byline supplies first names, not the supplied surnames in full. The canonical web parse contains report prose and footnotes but not the contents of the linked results figure. No PDF supplied; no linked material acquired. Unassigned original, effect-size and reported-success fields are placeholders. Whole-replication totals are not extracted as frame-specific analytic N. No analytic-N arithmetic performed. Target tests use log time; the printed interaction test and manipulation check do not substitute for simple effects.
